title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics enhancements + slo-toolkit helpers
author: Priya Malhotra
description: Motivation: on-call engineers need faster, higher-signal diagnostics when SLO/alert noise spikes. This PR adds a set of enhancements to incident-bot and companion utilities in the slo-toolkit to provide richer automated diagnostics, smarter runbook linking, and a new lightweight oncall helper endpoint consumed by the console. Summary of changes: 1) incident-bot: add an `autodiagnostics` pipeline stage that runs lightweight cross-checks (eg. recent deployment, infra error rates, KV cache hit rate) and attaches a short diagnosis summary to alerts; 2) slo-toolkit: expose helper library functions for computing correlated SLO deltas and top contributing metrics used by autodiagnostics; 3) runbook linking: improve matching heuristics by including SLO tags, service ownership metadata, and a fallback fuzzy-similarity scorer; 4) oncall helper endpoint: new HTTP endpoint /oncall/helpers that returns prioritized quicklinks and the autodiag summary for the active incident; 5) telemetry and tests: add metrics for autodiag latency and confidence, unit tests + integration test harness for the runbook matcher. The description below outlines rationale, implementation details, and testing notes. Rationale: previous autodiagnostics were brittle and returned long lists that oncall ignored. We focused on concise, high-signal summaries and prioritization: machine-detected probable root causes, a short confidence score, and 2-3 suggested runbook links. Implementation notes: - incident-bot: new package incident_bot.autodiag implementing a small rule engine and async runners with timeouts. Rules include: recent-deploy-check (looks for Kubernetes rollout events in last 15m), infra-error-spike-check (compares 5m vs 1h error rates), kv-cache-degradation (KV miss rate > 10% threshold), and model-serving-saturation (GPU queue depth > 80%). Each check returns {result, confidence, evidence_snippet} (serialized into a short string). Autodiag attaches the top 3 findings to the incident payload and emits metric incidentbot.autodiag.findings.count. - slo-toolkit: add slo_toolkit.autodiag_helpers with functions correlate_slo_delta, top_contributing_metrics, and compute_confidence_from_sample. These are pure helpers used by the rule engine and the console. - Runbook matcher: extended index to include slo_tags and owner_team; added fuzzy-similarity fallback using trigram scoring when exact tag matches yield no candidates. - Oncall endpoint: new lightweight endpoint guarded by RBAC that accepts an incident ID and returns JSON: {autodiag_summary, quicklinks}. Implemented caching for 30s to avoid overload during paging events. - Tests & CI: added unit tests for each rule and helper. Integration test simulates a rolling deploy with elevated errors to verify autodiag finds the deploy event. Telemetry uses existing metrics backend; added dashboard links in code comments for SRE. Backwards compatibility: all changes are additive. The autodiag pipeline is feature-flagged off by default and controlled via the existing incident-bot feature flags. Migration/ops notes: ops can enable the pipeline for specific teams via incident-bot config and tune thresholds. Also included a short tool in the slo-toolkit for generating synthetic SLO delta samples for local testing. CI: one flaky test (integration::runbook_matcher::fuzzy_score) failed on first run; I fixed a timing assumption and re-ran. Final CI green. Release notes: opt-in autodiagnostics for incident-bot and new slo-toolkit helpers for correlated SLO diagnostics.
commits: feat(autodiag): add autodiagnostics pipeline and rule engine
feat(slo-toolkit): add autodiag_helpers for SLO correlation and confidence scoring
feat(runbook-matcher): include slo_tags and owner metadata + fuzzy fallback
test: add unit and integration tests for autodiag and matcher
chore: add metrics and dashboard links
reviews: Danielle Ortiz: Left a request-change - the deploy-check currently queries k8s events synchronously which could add latency. Suggest switching to cached recent-events store or async call with timeout. Also asked for a clearer error model when dependencies (metrics backend) are unavailable.

Priya Malhotra (author): Responded - switched the deploy-check to use events cache and added a 300ms timeout for metadata calls. Added explicit diagnostic when metrics backend is unavailable and fallbacks to lightweight heuristics.

Marcus Li: Approved after minor nits - asked to add unit tests for the fuzzy scorer edge cases and suggested lowering default KV miss threshold to 8% for the next week rollout. Marcus also requested adding a feature flag gate for the API endpoint.
Ethan Park: Approved - sanity-checked metrics emission and dashboard links. Verified no PII is included in autodiag evidence snippets.
release_notes: Opt-in autodiagnostics for incident-bot (feature-flagged) and new slo-toolkit helpers for SLO correlation. Adds /oncall/helpers endpoint for prioritized quicklinks and diagnostics. Improve runbook matching with SLO tags and fuzzy fallback.
